# Families: Pythia(0,1), Qwen(2,3,4), OLMo(5), Llama(6), Mistral(7)
families = {
    0: 'Pythia', 1: 'Pythia',
    2: 'Qwen', 3: 'Qwen', 4: 'Qwen',
    5: 'OLMo', 6: 'Llama', 7: 'Mistral'
}

n = len(rows)
# Compute LOFO (leave-one-family-out): train on families != X, test on family X
# For each family, get the cells where training model != same family, test model is in family
# Actually LOFO in transfer matrix means: off-diagonal where train and test are from DIFFERENT families
cross_family = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i != j and families[i] != families[j]:
            cross_family.append(float(rows[i][j+1]))

print(f'Cross-family transfer (train/test from different families):')
print(f'  N cells: {len(cross_family)}')
print(f'  Mean F1: {np.mean(cross_family):.4f}')
print(f'  Median: {np.median(cross_family):.4f}')
print()

# Within-family off-diagonal
within_family = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i != j and families[i] == families[j]:
            within_family.append(float(rows[i][j+1]))

print(f'Within-family transfer (same family, different model):')
print(f'  N cells: {len(within_family)}')
print(f'  Mean F1: {np.mean(within_family):.4f}')
print()

# LOFO family-level: for each family, train on all OTHER families, test on this family
# This would be implemented differently - let me try the leave-one-family-out average
# from the transfer matrix perspective:
# For each family X: average F1 when training on non-X models and testing on X models
family_models = {}
for i, fam in families.items():
    family_models.setdefault(fam, []).append(i)

print('Family-level LOFO (train on other families, test on held-out family):')
family_lofo_scores = []
for fam, models in family_models.items():
    # test models = models in this family
    # train models = all models NOT in this family
    train_models = [i for i in range(n) if families[i] != fam]
    scores = []
    for test_idx in models:
        for train_idx in train_models:
            scores.append(float(rows[train_idx][test_idx + 1]))
    avg = np.mean(scores)
    family_lofo_scores.append(avg)
    print(f'  {fam}: avg transfer F1 = {avg:.4f} (from {len(scores)} cells)')

print(f'  Overall family LOFO mean: {np.mean(family_lofo_scores):.4f}')
